title: Fix autopkgtests for rustc-1.97 (LP #2166416 [1]).
description:
Fix autopkgtests for rustc-1.97 (LP #2166416 [1]).

This package builds successfully in a PPA [2], and the build-wasi autopkgtest that previously failed [3] now succeeds as build-wasm [4].

This MP also disables rustc's self-build autopkgtest since its results are flaky on autopkgtest infrastructure. This is a well-known issue (LP #2144934).

[1]: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/rustc-1.97/+bug/2166416
[2]: https://launchpad.net/~ruancomelli/+archive/ubuntu/fix-lp2166416/+sourcepub/18820205/+listing-archive-extra
[3]: https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/results/autopkgtest-stonking/stonking/amd64/r/rustc-1.97/20260826_135421_6571e@/log.gz
[4]: https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/results/autopkgtest-stonking-ruancomelli-fix-lp2166416/stonking/amd64/r/rustc-1.97/20261007_132004_1aefe@/log.gz
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 4f092e4..4df5f1e 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,12 @@
+rustc-1.97 (1.97.1+dfsg-0ubuntu2) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/tests: consolidate build-wasi and build-wasm-unknown into build-wasm,
+    pointing the wasm targets' linkers at the versioned wasm-ld-22
+    (LP: #2166416)
+  * d/tests: disable flaky selfbuild autopkgtest (LP: #2144934)
+
+ -- Ruan Comelli <ruan.comelli@canonical.com>  Tue, 06 Oct 2026 11:59:59 -0300
+
 rustc-1.97 (1.97.1+dfsg-0ubuntu1) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   * New upstream version 1.97.1 (LP: #2160247)
diff --git a/debian/tests/build-wasi b/debian/tests/build-wasm
similarity index 80%
rename from debian/tests/build-wasi
rename to debian/tests/build-wasm
index 5951a09..b19b0fa 100755
--- a/debian/tests/build-wasi
+++ b/debian/tests/build-wasm
@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
 #!/bin/bash
+# Test building each of the wasm targets.
 set -euox pipefail
 
 RUST_VERSION=$(dpkg-parsechangelog -SVersion | sed -re 's/([^.]+)\.([^.]+)\..*/\1.\2/')
@@ -34,9 +35,20 @@ replace-with = "vendored-sources"
 directory = "vendor"
 EOF
 
-# Build both wasi targets
+# wasm32-unknown-unknown and wasm32-wasip1 use `rust-lld` as their default
+# linker, which is not guaranteed to be installed under that name, so use
+# the versioned LLVM wasm linker instead.
+wasm_ld=/usr/bin/wasm-ld-22
+export CARGO_TARGET_WASM32_UNKNOWN_UNKNOWN_LINKER="$wasm_ld"
+export CARGO_TARGET_WASM32_WASIP1_LINKER="$wasm_ld"
+
+# wasm32-wasip2 uses wasm-component-ld as its outer linker, which in turn by default
+# searches PATH for `wasm-ld` or `rust-lld`. Neither unversioned name is guaranteed
+# to be installed, so pass the versioned wasm linker explicitly.
+export CARGO_TARGET_WASM32_WASIP2_RUSTFLAGS="-C link-arg=--wasm-ld-path=$wasm_ld"
+
 rc=0
-for target in wasm32-wasip1 wasm32-wasip2; do
+for target in wasm32-unknown-unknown wasm32-wasip1 wasm32-wasip2; do
     if ! ${CARGO} build --target "$target"; then
         echo "$target build failed" >&2
         rc=1
diff --git a/debian/tests/build-wasm-unknown b/debian/tests/build-wasm-unknown
deleted file mode 100755
index e677003..0000000

+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,16 +0,0 @@
-#!/bin/bash

-RUST_VERSION=$(dpkg-parsechangelog -SVersion | sed -re 's/([^.]+)\.([^.]+)\..*/\1.\2/')
-
-# Set RUSTC so that `cargo` knows which rustc to use
-export RUSTC=/usr/lib/rust-${RUST_VERSION}/bin/rustc
-CARGO=/usr/lib/rust-${RUST_VERSION}/bin/cargo
-
-tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
-cd "$tmpdir"
-
-${CARGO} new --lib hello
-cd hello
-
-${CARGO} build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
diff --git a/debian/tests/control b/debian/tests/control
index d008e8d..c58f963 100644
--- a/debian/tests/control
+++ b/debian/tests/control
@@ -1,22 +1,19 @@
-Test-Command: ./debian/rules build RUST_TEST_SELFBUILD=1

-Restrictions: rw-build-tree, allow-stderr

+# Depends: @, @builddeps@
+# Restrictions: rw-build-tree, allow-stderr
 # Other arches work but are flaky due to memory limitations.
 # Additionally, the test doesn't test for anything arch-specific.
-Architecture: amd64
+# Architecture: amd64
 
 Tests: create-and-build-crate
 Restrictions: allow-stderr
 Depends: @
 
-Tests: build-wasi
+Tests: build-wasm
 Restrictions: allow-stderr
 Depends: @, lld-22
 
-Tests: build-wasm-unknown
-Restrictions: allow-stderr

 Tests: versioned-cargo-wrapper
